about_the_game:
Frutiger Space is currently under development, and much of what you see is still a work-in-progress. If something appears incomplete or wonky, don't worry, it's either being updated or will be fixed in future updates!

An Overview

Frutiger Space is a social multiplayer game set in a retro-futuristic universe, like the aesthetic of the internet's heyday. Whether you're exploring, playing mini-games, accessorizing your Meeple, getting in on some secrets, or just rocking out to music bobbing in a bubble, there's never a moment of nothing to do!

Chat with Friends

Frutiger Space captures the essence of retro internet social games, giving you your place to chat with friends from the past, make new buddies, and be part of a friendly and welcoming community!

A World of Frutiger Subgenres

Each of our islands has its own personality, influenced by various Frutiger Aero subgenres, such as Frutiger Eco, Frutiger Aqua, Frutiger Metro, Technozen and more!

Meeple Customization

Your Meeple can be personalised with a huge selection of cosmetics. Express your personality with unique outfits, stylish hats, and accessories. You can spend new things with Frutiger Orbs, which are obtained by doing minigames, tasks/quests or by simply exploring the world to discover its riches.

Activities and Minigames

The game has a huge collection of minigames and activities, of course, no grinding and sweating, like:

  • Dolphin Racing

  • Watergun Battles

  • Fruit Collecting

  • And much more to come!
